notes.title: 1.2.0 — Lua & Localization
notes.content:
Hi, engineers!
Almost a month has passed since the last update – it's time to release a new one. It brings some new content to the game, but a lot of new features, and fixes a lot of bugs.
I would like to thank you for still playing our game after such a long stagnation. September 25, 2022 (the day after the release of update 1.1.0) there was a record number of active players – 131 people. I'd like to invite you to our Discord server, where you can find out about experimental releases and participate in discussions about future updates.

Programming in Lua

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/d562a8951d2650e0fbc66e82abbb9ed7d5cc68e0.png
Processor
Lua Processor is a new item that has a node with one Composite input and output. The main task is to carry out calculations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/f5fc3f78096bdf7f369c6696d7f7f69260604e8b.png
[Pong]
Display
Lua Display is a new item that has a node with one Composite input. The main task is to draw graphics in the game world.

Editor
To write code in the game, there is a built-in script editor, which includes documentation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/0dc0ccdbb1e30866c98d0a089388a417c4e38b8d.png

Localization
Now you can translate PixPhys into the language you are interested in, for this we have made a convenient utility that you can find along this path: PixPhys\Tools\Localization Tool. To start the translation, open the utility and open the default language in the game files (File>Open): PixPhys\GameData\Languages. On the left are localization keys, click on one of them and start editing its content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/19d5cc4d311f44cbc767df34920d7f886d8813ee.png

Improving the quality of life
Now you can collapse the list of props of a certain category by clicking on the arrow on the right.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/f9ce98717206174514cf30d0b73e9369d007dee0.png

Added the ability to fix the setting of weather events.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/661f609f34efc6629714e3ece5d0dcb48f842869.png

New props

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/84577a8a1d8ddccc80131efce4177198cf3a662c.png
Inertial gyroscope
[expand type=details]A device that has very heavy disks inside that accelerate to high speeds and due to this spin the spacecraft.[/expand]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/d2e950513ec9c62e80b3f90330ef3286ab95b408.png
Flare launcher
[expand type=details]When activated, fires a chemical projectile that flares up over time and begins to glow.[/expand]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/dc79d6e1d80112cbe694fb7976845ac802141819.png
Hand crank
[expand type=details]Allows you to set the shaft in motion, using only the labor of robots.[/expand]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/1d870db576f747838b314dd6f12d9e57e743f4a5.png
Glass sheet
[expand type=details]It's fragile.[/expand]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/166d19c661dffb4c1c5eef3aab1f0bbe5fff27b5.png
Hose
[expand type=details]This is a flexible pipe, perfect for connecting moving parts with a pipeline.[/expand]

New achievements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/5f4d3ebddb483e23e05d17a45fa0b5c4ef5809c9.png

Lua is now an integral part of PixPhys, which means highlighting its importance with three new achievements:

 Bug != Bug
 Documentation
 Optimization? What's this?

notes.title: PixPhys Beta is here!
notes.content:
Foreword

More than one year has passed since the last update of the game. Unfortunately, we brought the game to such a state that it was impossible to add content.

We made the first attempts to start development back in January 2022, when we wanted to take part in the Indie Cup competition. We did not have time to finish the game and the contest was cancelled. Due to some events, we had to abandon most of the ideas of the game that we called "PixPhys 2" as a joke, but some moved on to what is now PixPhys.

We started a full rework of PixPhys at the beginning of April 2022. From "PixPhys 2" was taken: workbench, weather and node system.

You probably won't find much in common between the Alpha version and the Beta version, as they are two different games with the same name and idea.

And now, after 5 months of active work, we are ready to present you PixPhys Beta!

[previewyoutube=WsN25SPxZgs;full][/previewyoutube]

Design on Steam

We have completely redesigned the store page. We made new screenshots and a trailer, added GIF to the text and stylized the titles, rewrote the description.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/90a2f21830cd8ae8758d2f4000abc589c0bb40f9.png

The images for the Steam client library have also been reworked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/bade2c5729c3743206e8518007883007e71d1193.png

What will happen to the Alpha version?

The alpha version of the game will be available as a another branch on Steam, which will not be updated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/72ea1c007c3388f621b6dfc5b7df2d93f63f67fc.png

Saves from the Alpha version cannot be played in the Beta version, so they are marked as "incompatible". You can read more about this here.

Innovations

The main innovations of the Beta version of PixPhys are:

 Workbench building system
 Node system
 Fuel system
 Weather
 Heating system
 Aerodynamics

You can read more about the development process, changes in our development logs:
[olist]
 Important news
  Development log, May 2022.
[/olist]

Achievements

Since the last devlog, we have added 15 achievements to the game:

 Brainfuck
 Junior-Developer
 Amphibian
 Perpetual engine
 Take a note
 Height is not scary
 Granite of science
 User manual
 Outer space
 Meteorological station
 Prestige
 Cheater
 Nuclear reactor
 *****
 *****

You can see each achievement in detail here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/0eb91a1a47f0d8e7ccd27322cd05d6d6c81bf3ea.png

Modifications

We've been working on user modification examples to help guide you through the modding process. All code is commented out in detail and disassembled into blocks. We are also working on modding documentation. If you have any difficulties feel free to write to our Discord server!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/3adc7a73578cabc44fa2c97cc7434c50febf4d7c.png

Statuses

We have integrated support for Steam and Discord statuses into the game. Now your friends will see what you are doing: you are in the menu, testing or building your new creation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/8068bbdd01c54306eb2ab6f432f174b7d620b934.png

notes.title: Development Journal, May 2022.
notes.content:
Greeting

Hello Engineers! This is the promised development log, in which we assume and possibly what we have managed to do since the beginning of the development of PixPhys BETA (development began on April 8) and what our plans are. Also at the end of the post, you must apply for participation in closed beta testing.

I would like to note that we have finished making the main "skeleton" of the game, and at present we are filling it with game content: we are restoring the game content of the upgraded version and developing new gameplay features.

[previewyoutube=fVI7vTrKVT0;full][/previewyoutube]

Editors

We're especially focusing on editors, as they're the main places where you'll spend your time designing insane devices.

Transport editor

The appearance of the transport editor now looks like this:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/e5067ab1ee39e6bafe7db39914ffcad9367341c0.png
And Toybox has been completely redesigned:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/394cf1ae89b734c06744e968b99612bb66e73df1.png
At the moment, there are 77 different characteristics in the game, which are divided into several categories: aerodynamics, decorative, displays, explosives, lighting, fluids, propulsion, mechanics, sensors.

The toolbar has been improved:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/80da6c74014f95fc62d451aadddb315c24d5c195.png
Socket Editor

As you know from the publication that was published earlier, the logic system has turned into a socket editor.
In the socket editor, you can find two types of nodes:
[olist]
 Dependent
 Independent
[/olist]

Dependent nodes are those nodes that belong to the created prop in the transport editor. Independent, respectively, are those nodes that do not belong to props, they can be created through a special menu of a special node.
At the moment, there are over fifty unique nodes in the game. Most of them were added according to your wishes.

Fuel system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/c50cbf3739af1496e975a886363c4f4f06f6c07e.png

Now, in order to start the engine, you will probably need its fuel. In the screenshot above, you can see the fuel tanks that connect to the rocket engine through a separator to connect these 3 components to each other, which are routed by themselves, using solid collision joints.

Temperature 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/846d33d85eb4c06efd3d842c4f62f12d07ac4ae2.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/287e7d66a6363815c3761810c405ca9802892041.png

In the new version, we decided to work out the liveliness of the world. The first step was to add the weather. Now, in addition to changing the time of day, the weather cycle is changing, which includes precipitation and nebula.

Testing 

At the moment, there is a version for closed testing for performance. But we would like to improve the efficiency of this process by recruiting testers, so we are recruiting! To enter, you need to make an interesting build in PixPhys that showcases your skills and complete the survey.

notes.title: Important news
notes.content:
Hello engineers! A lot of time has passed since the last news on Steam, during this time several news have appeared, which we will introduce you to in this post ːwinter2019happyyulː

Birthday
PixPhys celebrates 1 year! This year the total number of players has increased to over 5,000. There were 223 items on the Steam Workshop: 203 saves, 11 mods, 9 guides. Thank you for creating content for PixPhys, we appreciate it ːluvː

PixPhys Beta
During our absence, we gained experience, and at the same time experimented with new mechanics for PixPhys. In this regard, we came to the conclusion that we need to rework PixPhys from the inside: rewrite some mechanics and add new ones. We are currently working on PixPhys Beta, a completely redesigned version of the game. Now we will introduce you some global changes.

• New connection system
We decided to change the logical connections to the socket editor (a visual editor of logical connections, consisting of nodes and input and output sockets).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/1dd494f5ca573f1c1a1b960103b10a7f5ca32fc9.gif

• Vehicle Editor
Creation of vehicles will take place in a separate vehicle editor for greater convenience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/48f7471a2bc0e91f86843400636e2ebe779c6bef.png

• Aerodynamics
We are experimenting with the aerodynamic physics of props. If we make sure that it works correctly, then it will be added to the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/4eefb8edd824466e144da5611440fec13bee8d47.gif

Details of other changes will be provided in the next development log, which will be published by the end of May. You can also follow the development in our Discord Server.

notes.title: August 2021 Devlog.
notes.content:
Hello, Engineers!

Hello Engineers of the first category! You've probably already noticed that there have been no updates for over a month. At first glance, it may seem that we are not doing anything because we didn’t release devlogs on Discord and we didn’t release new experimental versions, but this is not the case. This article should tell you about everything that we have been doing all this time.

• Main menu UI update.

When creating this update, we were very much concerned that many newcomers could not figure out the game on their own. The first step towards solving this problem was to rework the old menu into a more beautiful, functional and understandable. We have optimized the navigation of the players in the menu, moved some old functions to more appropriate places, and added new ones that simplify the interaction with the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/42fd34c3582044b010a3319075e8bcad0d6cbba5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/074ffdbf9184376ae10afd87c07672bdf93b7d97.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/e573715d4daca85f795dd4bb0875de59d3634f3f.png

• Multiplayer.

Also in this update, work continued on the multiplayer. More sync items have been added and network code optimizations have been made. It is highly likely that in the final version of this update, multiplayer will be available in alpha access.

Adding multiplayer to a game that is not intended for him is a very difficult process, especially for one person, so it can take a long time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/b6c18735ed4961fe7e24c156f31932e381e2531e.png

• Display of problem areas.

The continuation of the solution to the problem of the difficulty of understanding the game is to add to the game a system for displaying problem areas of your contraptions. It will display a special icon in places worth paying attention to.

For example, if you forgot to connect the power to the device, the game will remind you of this. This will help avoid confusion and show the player what needs to be fixed in his contraption in order for it to work correctly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/367a061611e3af5b928bcffa6b9c719503ade984.png

• Fuel system and new engine.

As mentioned earlier, we are working on a new fuel system that should bring more variety and complexity to the game when building vehicles. At the moment, only the new jet engine has been optimized for this system.

For the operation of this engine, it is required to build a specific structure from connected modular blocks: an air intake, a combustion chamber, and a nozzle. After the design of this structure, it is required to bring the fuel line to the combustion chamber and the tank with aviation fuel.

I would like to clarify that fluid physics works on a simplified model. This means that the fluid inside the pipe is not affected by gravity. At the moment, this works on the principle of pressure differences in different parts of the system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/76fbb98d15b224c0e1ede7afd6ae2d9282212df5.png

• Updated particles.

Also in this update all the effects (clouds, smoke, fire and etc.) is redrawn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/cd64896e1ad1a71771c327ad30d0a2fa287a80e7.png

• Best Community Contraptions.

As our game is developing very quickly, it needs to update the screenshots and trailer, which will more clearly reflect the gameplay. We would be happy to select the best work from the community for this task. We will write more about the competition later.

• Conclusion.

In conclusion, first I would like to clarify that at the moment we do not know when this update will be fully released, but a new experimental version will be released very soon. We would like to hear from you in the comments what difficulties you encountered at the beginning of the game in order to try to get rid of them.

Also, if there are players among you who are quite familiar with the game, we would be glad if you could write your own guides on Steam, because it will help newcomers to get used to it.

notes.title: Electricity update (0.8)
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/LRg0GxZ.gif
Hi engineers!

A month has passed since the last update, which means it's time for a new update! This update brings a ton of content to the game. The main innovation in this update is the addition of electricity.

Electricity.

As mentioned earlier, this part of the update is the main one. Therefore, most of the new content belongs to it. A significant number of appliances in the game now require electricity to operate. It is logical that in order to use electricity, it must be obtained somehow, for this there are such items as a Generator, a Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator, and a Solar Panel. Also, electrical connections are not built in the same way as logical ones - they do not have inputs and outputs, they are all something in between.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/58dd054815b99a48a2ec12fac11c69fe6cf30fe0.png

Icon caching.

In this update, icon caching was added, which means that loading when entering the game will be reduced or completely lost. Now it will only happen once per game update. All icons will be stored in the following path:

C: /Users/ YourUsername /AppData/LocalLow/RedStarhip/PixPhys/Thumbnails

New interface.

In this update, almost the entire game interface has been changed, except for the menu. Added slots for easier construction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/20793ce4b12d07217a64a80dd8912dee78446a4d.png

New music.

Now PixPhys has completely new music from another composer, as well as ambient for being near the surface and in space.

[previewyoutube=z5l11hO4mUQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Change settings.

Now you can disable in the settings: at home in the background on the flat card, post processing, output of system messages to the console, adjust the volume of the music.

Multiplayer.

Work has begun on multiplayer. At the moment, it works very badly and therefore ordinary players cannot enter it now.

 The number of tags in the Steam Workshop has been increased.
 Added helicopter engine.
 Added helicopter blades.
[/olist]

notes.title: Shafts (0.7)
notes.content:
Introduction

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/8b928f9c702430cf7aedf8b9301d68b53da8a9ef.gif

Good day, dear players!

It's already the end of the month and we, as promised, are releasing an update! This update greatly complements the game and adds to it: shafts, composite signal, a new instrument, cosmetic world changes, copying and much more! Let's talk about this more specifically.

Shafts (main innovation)

A shaft system has been added to the game, which shouldn't make your life much more difficult 😊. The standard propulsion systems (propeller and wheel) will remain in the game, but you will quickly tire of simple structures. The new type of wheel and propeller uses a shaft for movement, which you can set in motion with an electric motor, but note that its power may not be enough for large buildings and you will need to use a gearbox. Use a tachometer to measure shaft speed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/e947d9e84cef8c5512e475d5620c3ff23d6c55eb.png

Copy

In the update we added copying of buildings, but be careful as this feature doesn't work very well yet. It allows, as you understand it, to create clones of your buildings, as well as transfer them between worlds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/77a689ec565441b910662ab86e7590ea7e72d6c7.png

Blowtorch

A new blowtorch tool has been added to the game. With it, you can improve your beams and ropes, which will make them more durable.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/aa3012f1ac4da9ed3cb23762c667512e881a5325.png

Training 

A tab has been added to the main menu that briefly describes the basics of the game to make it easier for new players to get started with our game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/cb1f485c96ab1b11958510b9e4618630a73b51f0.png

Processor

The processor is designed to create constructions with a miscalculation of any logic at the code level. This should allow players to create anything from a compact calculator to in-game games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/d389400e936ce233595346181ffeebfdfa5e81e0.png

Composite compounds

A composite data type is a kind of data packet into which you can write or read any information from it. To write information you need a new subject “Composite data writer”, the main thing is not to forget to set the variable key in it. And in order to read you need a “Composite data reader”, you also need to enter a key.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/7f819c31518883415c29414d061984e7ae95bb0c.png

Minor changes

[olist]
 Drag Tool has been redesigned.
 Added a barrel.
 Added barometer.
 Added an angular velocity (rotation) sensor.
 Added electromagnet.
 Added a logical lever.
[/olist]

notes.title: Tools update (0.6)
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/vyxLPGm.gif
Good day, Engineers!
The second update for our young game is coming out today. It comes out 2 to 3 weeks after the release.
This update brings new tools, items, achievements to the game, bugs fixed.

Robot.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/5f46a6a7ba34ac77e3842b58cf599cea5db574ac.png
One of the interesting innovations is the robot. With it, you can revive Charles, or you can make a robo-landing.

Localization.
Work has begun on a localization system. It was created to support other languages ​​by the game (not officially). After finalizing this system, the Workshop will be able to publish and download your localization options.

Workshop.
In this update, Steam Workshop was affected. We've changed the save tags, and now it's easier to find buildings that fit your needs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/d921154874ee23197f3efd002bf86eca4935feee.png

Also, for this function, the procedure for publishing saves to the workshop has been updated and a corresponding window has been added.

Bearings.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40147320/369754736949cff9359cc9d05921c70d1c8186cf.png
This update introduces bearings with which you can create movable joints and pneumatic mechanisms, like this landing gear.

Mod cache.
The game now has a system for caching mod files. For example, this is needed if you have a music player and you load several audio files into it when you spawn. The computer will take time to do this, and in order not to repeat this operation, the game will save the data about the file to memory.

Achievements.
2 new achievements have been added.
1 - Take Charles to space without touching.
2 - Create 1000 logical links.

Mechanisms.
Button press mode - requires pressing the button.
Logic gate - does not pass the signal if there is no signal at the middle input.
CMG - use it to spin your building around it.
Advanced speedometer mode - allows you to get speed along different axes.
Impact detector - in a collision, returns the force of the collision.

notes.title: Alpha release
notes.content:
Introduction
We think you're got tired waiting this moment, and finally your wait comes to an end!
Yes! We release our creation on a free voyage (almost)
Yes, that is not full release of the game, but this is steam release. That moment, when our approach to the game must be serious.
Besides release, we have few other news.
0.4 and 0.5 changelog
0.4
Added:
-Matress
-Vector2
-Vector2 converter
-Warp drive
-Light bulb
-Steam workshop
Fixed/changed:
-Bugfixes
-Complete texture rework
-Small ModAPI rework
0.5
Added:
-Nuke
-Clocks
-New map (Planet)
-Sounds for piston
-Saves support for workshop
Fixed/changed:
-Bugfixes
h3 Deleted:
-Lamp
Warp Drive
Like it was said in changelog, we added warp drive. What is warp drive? In our game this is device with which you can "teleport" in any point of space-time. It has 3 inputs and 1 output. Output is progress of warp drive's charging. Two inputs that have red color are charging switch and functioning switch. Third input is coordinates.
Conclusion
In conclusion, we want to say that one of the most difficult things we have already gone through. Enjoy the update and wait for the news!
